meta.title: Software and web solutions for businesses | BMM Cesar
meta.description: Business websites, B2B catalogues, enquiry systems, Excel automation, and focused custom software for Slovenian companies.

hero.title: Web solutions for less manual work.
hero.text: I build business websites, B2B catalogues, enquiry systems, data automation, and focused software tools shaped around how your company actually works.
hero.coreHint: Data is checked, organized, and used only where it genuinely helps.

beyond.title: Not only an online presentation
beyond.text: A good website presents a company clearly. A business solution can also participate in the daily workflow and reduce copying between separate tools.
beyond.websiteText: Services, references, contact details, and clear enquiry actions help visitors understand your business and contact you easily.
beyond.solutionTitle: A business solution handles the next step
beyond.solutionText: It can collect a structured enquiry, display data from existing files, prepare information for a quotation, or generate a document without repetitive entry.

services.title: Solutions for concrete business workflows
services.intro: Scope follows the actual problem. Sometimes a clear website is enough; in other cases, a catalogue, structured form, automation, or focused internal tool makes sense.

items.title: Business websites
items.text: Fast, clear websites designed around trust, services, references, and a straightforward way to contact the company.

items.title: B2B catalogues and enquiries
items.text: For products whose prices depend on quantity, dimensions, configuration, transport, installation, or a customer agreement.
features: Product import from Excel or CSV

items.title: Forms and quotation preparation
items.text: The customer enters measurements and options, while the company receives data it can immediately use to prepare a quotation.
features: Data for PDF or work orders
Automatic calculations where rules are clear

items.title: Excel and data automation
items.text: Less manual copying across files, price lists, product lists, reports, and exchanges between existing systems.
features: Data for a website or existing system

items.title: Focused custom software
items.text: Small applications with a clearly defined input, process, and output—without unnecessary scope.

workflows.title: From scattered data to a useful outcome
workflows.intro: These are not references or completed customer projects. They are concrete workflow examples that can be simplified when the rules and desired result are sufficiently clear.

commerce.title: Online store or enquiry system?
commerce.text: Both can be appropriate, but they support different sales processes. Before development, it is important to understand how the price is really determined and what sales needs before confirming an order.
commerce.storeText: Suitable for products with a clear price, stock status, delivery method, and standard buying process.
storePoints: Use of an established commerce platform
Connections to existing data where useful
commerce.enquiryText: Often a better fit for B2B, made-to-order products, and quotations that require additional data or a salesperson's review.
enquiryPoints: A complete and readable request for sales
commerce.note: There is no value in rebuilding payments, shopping carts, or established commerce infrastructure from scratch. The useful work is in the setup, data, forms, and connections around your actual sales process.

process.title: From one concrete problem to a usable solution
process.intro: The process is suitable for small businesses: no lengthy consulting engagement, but enough review to clearly understand the problem before development begins.

items.title: Conversation
items.text: We discuss the current workflow and the result you want.

items.title: Workflow review
items.text: We review the files, forms, documents, and systems used today.

items.title: Solution proposal
items.text: I define the scope, output, limitations, and implementation estimate.

items.title: Build and verification
items.text: The solution is built against agreed examples and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Handover and support
items.text: You receive the solution, agreed guidance, and data-export options.

principles.eyebrow: What the work is based on
principles.title: Clear rules instead of large promises

items.title: Clearly defined scope
items.text: Before work begins, we define what is included and what is not.

items.title: No unnecessary features
items.text: Every feature must support a real part of your workflow.

items.title: Human confirmation
items.text: Important decisions remain under the control of a responsible person.

items.title: Data export options
items.text: We agree how your data can also be retrieved from the system.

items.title: Fits existing work
items.text: The goal is not to replace everything, but to improve the right step.

items.title: Incremental delivery
items.text: We verify with realistic examples and expand only where it makes sense.

about.label: BMM software specialization
about.title: Personal and accountable collaboration
about.text: I develop software solutions as an independent specialization within the BMM brand. I am not a large agency and I do not promise a system for every problem. I first want to understand one concrete workflow, then propose a solution that can be clearly explained, verified, and used.

contact.title: Tell me how your workflow works today
contact.text: If you often copy data between email, Excel, Word, and other systems, describe one concrete example. Together we can assess whether simplifying it would make sense.
contact.note: A short description of the current work and the result you want is enough to begin.

footer.description: BMM Cesar is a family team of three brothers combining construction, mechanics, and software into practical project delivery.

about.subtitle: BMM Cesar is built by three brothers with different skills and one shared standard: quality execution.
about.missionText: We are not trying to be a generic agency. We combine field work, machine knowledge, and digital delivery in one team.

about.teamText: We are still in an early growth phase, so we stay realistic, responsive, and direct in communication.
